Brightwell Labs, Inc.
STOCK OPTION GRANT NOTICE

Date of Grant: April 20, 2027
Type of Option: Incentive Stock Option
The Company grants you an option to purchase 50,000 shares of Common Stock at an exercise price of $0.90 per share.
This option represents 0.25% of the fully diluted shares as of April 1, 2027.
The fully diluted capitalization of the Company was 20,000,000 shares as of April 1, 2027.
